```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggnewscale)
library(plotly)
library(tiff)
library(grid)
library(rcoleo)

# custom function for pictograms
annotation_custom2 <-
    function(grob, xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, data) {
        layer(
            data = data, stat = StatIdentity, position = PositionIdentity,
            geom = ggplot2:::GeomCustomAnn,
            inherit.aes = TRUE, params = list(
                grob = grob,
                xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax,
                ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax
            )
        )
    }

# data
sites <- coleo_request_general("sites", response_as_df = TRUE, schema = "public")
sites <- sites |>
    mutate(lon = sapply(geom$coordinates, "[", 1)) |>
    mutate(lat = sapply(geom$coordinates, "[", 2)) |>
    as.data.frame()

inext_estimates <- readRDS("/home/local/USHERBROOKE/juhc3201/BdQc/ReseauSuivi/Data/summer_blitz_rarefaction/inext_estimates_per_sites.rds")
# visualisation
inext_estimates$prop_obs <- (inext_estimates$sp_observed / inext_estimates$sp_estimator) * 100

# inext_estimates <- left_join(inext_estimates, sites[, c("site_code", "lat", "lon")], by = join_by(code_site == site_code))
inext_sf <- st_as_sf(inext_estimates, coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = st_crs(4326))
qc <- st_read("https://object-arbutus.cloud.computecanada.ca/bq-io/acer/reseau_suivi_data/QUEBEC_regions/sf_CERQ_SHP/QUEBEC_CR_NIV_01.gpkg")
qc2 <- st_union(qc)
qc3 <- st_transform(qc2, crs = st_crs(inext_sf))

# for adding picto
bat <- readTIFF("/home/local/USHERBROOKE/juhc3201/BdQc/ReseauSuivi/portail_pictograms/bq_couleur/bat_darkblue.tiff")
ortho <- readTIFF("/home/local/USHERBROOKE/juhc3201/BdQc/ReseauSuivi/portail_pictograms/bq_couleur/ortho_yellow.tiff")
ins <- readTIFF("/home/local/USHERBROOKE/juhc3201/BdQc/ReseauSuivi/portail_pictograms/bq_couleur/coleo_brown.tiff")
oiseau <- readTIFF("/home/local/USHERBROOKE/juhc3201/BdQc/ReseauSuivi/portail_pictograms/bq_couleur/bird_blue.tiff")
vegetation <- readTIFF("/home/local/USHERBROOKE/juhc3201/BdQc/ReseauSuivi/portail_pictograms/bq_couleur/plant_green.tiff")


pic_bat <- annotation_custom2(rasterGrob(bat, interpolate = TRUE), xmin = -69, xmax = -66, ymin = 58.5, ymax = 61.5, data = inext_sf[1, ])
pic_bird <- annotation_custom2(rasterGrob(oiseau, interpolate = TRUE), xmin = -69, xmax = -66, ymin = 58.5, ymax = 61.5, data = inext_sf[228, ])
pic_ortho <- annotation_custom2(rasterGrob(ortho, interpolate = TRUE), xmin = -69, xmax = -66, ymin = 58.5, ymax = 61.5, data = inext_sf[373, ])
pic_ins <- annotation_custom2(rasterGrob(ins, interpolate = TRUE), xmin = -69, xmax = -66, ymin = 58.5, ymax = 61.5, data = inext_sf[505, ])
pic_vege <- annotation_custom2(rasterGrob(vegetation, interpolate = TRUE), xmin = -69, xmax = -66, ymin = 58.5, ymax = 61.5, data = inext_sf[453, ])
```


```{r chiro, fig.show = "hold", out.width = "100%", height = "100%", echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
inext_map <- inext_sf |>
    ggplot() +
    geom_sf(
        data = qc3
    ) +
    # layer for chiropteres
    geom_sf(data = subset(inext_sf, type_campaign == "chiropteres"), aes(
        size = prop_obs,
        color = prop_obs,
        alpha = -prop_obs
    )) +
    scale_color_gradient(low = "#000000", high = "#242e86") +
    labs(x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude") +
    theme(
        legend.position = "none",
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text.x = element_blank(),
        text = element_text(size = 20),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = "transparent"),
    )
ggplotly(inext_map + pic_bat)
```

```{r insecte, fig.show = "hold", out.width = "100%", height = "100%", echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
inext_map <- inext_sf |>
    ggplot() +
    geom_sf(
        data = qc3
    ) +
    # layer for insecte_sol
    geom_sf(data = subset(inext_sf, type_campaign == "insecte_sol"), aes(
        size = prop_obs,
        color = prop_obs,
        alpha = -prop_obs
    )) +
    scale_color_gradient(low = "#000000", high = "#b88157") +
    ggfun::geom_image(aes(x = -59, y = 58.5), img = ins) +
    labs(x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude") +
    theme(
        legend.position = "none",
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text.x = element_blank(),
        text = element_text(size = 20),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = "transparent"),
    )
tot_plot <- inext_map + pic_ins
ggplotly(tot_plot)
```
